question: Does the RTX 5090 materially accelerate a useful end-to-end full-covariance DESI DR2 CPL profile-likelihood surface?
hypothesis: A million-point batched full-covariance CPL profile surface is large enough to amortize GPU setup while remaining checkable against float64 CPU and scalar quadrature references.
assumptions_and_units: Flat late-time CPL only; radiation/curvature omitted; alpha=c/(H0 rd) profiled.
Distances and BAO observables are dimensionless ratios to rd.
The Sobol domain is a screening box, not a prior or posterior sample.

model_parameters_and_priors.sampling: 2^20 scrambled Sobol points, uniform only for surface scan

nuisance_parameters.alpha: analytic full-covariance least-squares profile, bounded to stated interval

training_validation_holdout_definition: No training/emulator/holdout; CPU and GPU evaluate the same complete Sobol batches, plus a 128-point scalar adaptive-quadrature subset.
covariance_order_and_overlap_treatment: Full released 13x13 covariance in the original 13-row mean order; no additional probes combined.
command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/run_bounded.py --seconds 900 -- .venv/bin/python experiments/gpu_bao_surface/benchmark_bao_surface.py --powers 20 --chunk-size 4096 --adaptive-check-points 128 --pool-limit-gib 2 --output experiments/gpu_bao_surface/result.json --surface experiments/gpu_bao_surface/surface.npz

hardware.cpu_reference: one core, float64, BLAS/OpenMP threads capped at one

metric_definition: Throughput and wall-clock speed ratio for identical full-covariance profile-surface end-to-end tasks; GPU time includes import/context initialization, transfers, synchronization and result transfer.

results.interpretation_of_minimum: lowest Sobol sample only, not a refitted global optimum

uncertainty: No sampling uncertainty; this is a computational benchmark and exploratory finite surface, not a posterior scan.

attempts_counted_in_search.first_pilot_harness_error: self-check unpacking bug; preserved in report and corrected before full runs

interpretation_and_limits: A measured workload-specific RTX 5090 speedup supports GPU use for dense profile surfaces; it does not imply the small 13-point optimizer benefits, nor any cosmological claim. CuPy was installed only in the project venv. Existing GPU services were untouched.
independent_reviewer: Float64 CPU reference, prediction API assertion, adaptive SciPy scalar quadrature/full covariance subset; Luna Max compute worker reported exact paths and hashes.
review_disposition: Benchmark reproduced with explicit end-to-end setup costs; early pilot error retained and not used for final claim.
next_test: Use accelerated grid evaluations only where downstream profile refinement is useful; final scientific estimates should use exact checked CPU/double or higher precision.
